# Generated by components/desktop/test/desktop_host_test.cpp --gen; edit the
# catalogue there, not this file. Shared by the C++ host test (encoders must
# reproduce the hex, decoders must reproduce the value) and the web app's node
# test (decode(hex) must equal the JSON for d2h, encode(JSON) the hex for h2d).
#
# One vector per line: name<TAB>d2h|h2d<TAB>type hex<TAB>payload hex<TAB>decoded JSON
# (payload hex has no spaces; an empty payload is an empty field).
#
# JSON shapes (numbers are plain, strings are UTF-8):
#   prop        {tag, value} where value is by tag: Text-like -> string; Value/Min/Max/Step
#               -> int; Enabled/Visible/Focus/ItemCount/Flags/MaxLines/Width/Height/
#               InsertBefore/WindowFlags/Color/Background -> uint; Items ->
#               {start, items[]}; Columns -> [strings]; Geometry -> {x,y,w,h};
#               an unknown tag (or a malformed known one) -> {tag, raw: hex}
#   widget      {id, parent, type, weight, layout, props[]}
#   DESKTOP     {proto, flags, records[prop], apps[{id, flags, name, icon, description}],
#               windows[{id, app}]}
#   WINDOW_OPEN {window, app, flags, x, y, w, h, title, total, widgets[]}
#   WINDOW_CLOSE {window, reason}   WIDGET_SET {window, entries[{widget, props[]}]}
#   WIDGET_ADD  {window, widgets[]}  WIDGET_REMOVE {window, widgets[ids]}
#   DIALOG      {dialog, owner, kind, icon, title, text, default, buttons[]}
#   NOTIFY      {level, timeoutMs, title, text}   DIALOG_CLOSE {dialog}
#   OK          {request}   ERROR {request, errno, message}
#   GET_DESKTOP {}   LAUNCH_APP {app}   CLOSE_WINDOW {window}
#   WINDOW_EVENT {window, event, x, y, w, h}
#   WIDGET_EVENT {window, widget, event} + by event: Change/Select/Activate/Scroll {value},
#               Submit {text}, Text {offset, total, text}, Key {key, mods, codepoint}
#   DIALOG_RESULT {dialog, button, text}
